_comment: Each series keeps one open round (or pair). When its entry window closes, the scheduler opens the next one. Blocks: ~0.3 s on Monad testnet (1 h = 12000). Keep durationBlocks a bit below entryBlocks, so the previous position on the same market is closed before the next one opens. endAtUtc: the round always ends at this UTC time (Round of the day); entry is open until durationBlocks before it. endDow: day of week for endAtUtc (0 = Sunday). waitSettle: open the next round only after the previous one settled. jackpot: bonus starts at base, grows by step (up to max) after a round nobody won, resets after a win.

rounds.description: Round of the day: where does ETH go by 18:00 UTC? Bulls side, 12x on Perpl.
rounds.rules: Start price: Perpl price when entry closes. Final: price at 18:00 UTC. Above the start price: Bulls win. Your money always comes back.

rounds.description: Round of the day: where does ETH go by 18:00 UTC? Bears side, 12x on Perpl.
rounds.rules: Start price: Perpl price when entry closes. Final: price at 18:00 UTC. Below the start price: Bears win. Your money always comes back.

rounds.description: Quick round: SOL goes up in 15 minutes. The prize pool trades a 10x SOL long on Perpl.
rounds.rules: Strike: Perpl price when entry closes. Final: price at the end. Above strike wins. Your money always comes back.

rounds.description: Jackpot of the week: SOL by Sunday 18:00 UTC. Bulls side.
rounds.rules: Start price: Perpl price when entry closes (Sunday 17:00 UTC). Final: price at Sunday 18:00 UTC. Your side right: three players share the jackpot (80/15/5). Nobody wins: the jackpot grows by 50 USD next week. Your money always comes back.
